paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 6.29, with a change of -1.72% compared to the prior close and 3.97% over a window of 22 sessions. There have been 3 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Sources such as Seeking Alpha and Blockonomi have reported on this development, citing the subpoena and its potential impact on the company.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, as well as an 8-K form announcing the appointment of a new Chief Executive Officer, Lee McIntire, with an annualized base salary of $750,000. Additionally, there has been one Form 4 filing, indicating some level of insider activity.
